## Decision lines carried verbatim

- `D-K2-1 [A-10] = b + c` — published pages only for registry auto-allowed
  organisations; every other organisation is a typed `not_yet_reviewed` row,
  never a keyed page, never a raw identifier. The page consumes `pageState`
  / `entityIndex` from the P36.41 contract — it does not re-decide them.
- `D-K14-2 [B-22]` brand set — carried by the chrome; nothing added here.
- `sig.entity-page/1` contract A — rendered, never re-shaped: contract-B
  sections (contradictions, timeline, related pages, statement/relationship
  download artifacts) render typed empty states, not gaps (SIG-UI-086).
- `ER_DISCLOSURE` / `WITHHELD_RELATIONSHIPS_NOTICE` — rendered verbatim from
  the contract, never re-worded (UXR-20; SIG-UI-080).

## What landed

- `web/src/lib/entity-pages.ts` — the page model: kind display words (never
  raw tokens), direction/access-kind words in prose (H-2), `mergeEntityTwins`
  (the ADR-106 per-compartment union — the same claim filed under two
  compartments renders once; JSON downloads stay per-compartment), A–Z list
  pagination (`ENTITY_LIST_PAGE_SIZE = 100` → `/entity/<type>/page/<n>/`),
  `emittedEntityPaths` (the `/id/` stub's emitted-successor test), and the
  `NOT_YET_REVIEWED_STATE`/`TWIN_MISSING_STATE` typed five-part states.
- `web/src/pages/entity/index.astro` — the Organizations hub (SIG-UI-070):
  per-type counts as `<Figure>` with a pointer into the label stream, the ER
  disclosure verbatim beside every count, per-type A–Z links, the typed
  review-state section, and the typed whole-index empty state.
- `web/src/pages/entity/[type]/index.astro` + `page/[n].astro` — the
  per-type paginated A–Z lists; published rows link their keyed pages; typed
  `not_yet_reviewed` rows render the A-10 state.
- `web/src/pages/entity/[type]/[key]/index.astro` — the 06a template (K2
  §4.2): header (label, descriptor, kind word, label basis, place, review
  status), summary lines (numbers via `<Figure>` into the twin), the
  Identifiers block (raw keys legal only here, SIG-UI-108), "What SIG
  records" claim groups with the four epistemic fields separate
  (SIG-UI-004), one relationship table per relation × direction × access
  kind (the three kinds never merge, SIG-UI-024) carrying the H-2 fields —
  counterparty, role, date kind, currency, support, source, per-claim
  evidence links — with historical and undated rows marked and excluded from
  present-tense text (SIG-UI-116/088); degree-only facts as sentences, never
  edges (SIG-UI-117); the contract-B typed empty section; downloads (the
  per-compartment JSON twin links); cite (SIG id + release + record link);
  technical details; and the claim-provenance section — one J3 panel per
  named claim via `ProvenancePanelShell` (the single emitter), so every row
  reaches provenance in one action with and without JavaScript
  (SIG-UI-122).
- `web/src/pages/entity/[type]/[key]/index.[comp].json.ts` — the JSON twin
  endpoint emitting the `sig.entity-page/1` bytes the page renders (the
  download the contract names).
- `web/src/pages/id/[type]/[uuid].astro` — the coarse `ENTITY_PAGES_EMIT`
  gate became a per-target emitted check (`emittedEntityPaths`): a stub
  refreshes/links only to an entity page this build actually emits
  (K13 R-6 — never link a 404); unemitted successors keep the honest
  explanation variant.
- `web/src/lib/release-routes.ts` — the `entity/<type>/` route-set probe so
  nav offers a type's list exactly when the label registry keys it.
- `web/src/lib/nav.ts` — Organizations section: hub + the three type lists
  (kind words), and the stale `entity/organization/` route spelling
  corrected to `entity/org/` (the contract's url_type).
- `web/src/lib/statements-fixture.ts` — two appended `sig.statement/1`
  fixture rows (`clm-apd-vigilant-1` `legacy_synthetic`, `clm-apd-name-1`
  `document_only`) so the entity page's provenance panels exercise real
  binding states; unfixtured claims still render the honest `not_recorded`
  panel.
- `web/src/lib/figures.ts` + `web/scripts/check-figures.mjs` —
  `LABEL_STREAM_RE` + `ENTITY_TWIN_RE` admit the label streams and entity
  twins as figure artifacts by pattern (like the compartment streams; the

- `web/src/components/EpistemicFields.astro` — a visible separator between
  field name and value (NEW-7 glued-boundary sweep; `/entity/**` is the

- `ops/public_routes.toml` — `entity` joined `top_level` + `required` (the

- `web/lighthouserc*.json` — regenerated via `gen-lhci.mjs` for the new

- `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-05.md` — the EN-* copy rows for

- `CHANGELOG.md` `## [Unreleased]` — the public-behaviour entry.
- Tests: `web/tests/unit/entity-pages.test.ts` (merge/pagination/kind

## Fix arc

1. `check-root-absolute-paths` red — 10 literal `/entity/…` sites in new
   pages → `path={withBase("entity/…")}` + `ROOT_POINTER` constants; no new
   sites measured.
2. Build red — `lexicon has no resolution state resolved` then `no currency
   state UNDATED`: the twin's envelope words are lowercase / `UNDATED` is a
   date-kind word → envelope uppercased for `EpistemicFields`; `UNDATED`
   renders the muted "undated" word rather than a lexicon lookup.
3. `check:lexicon` red — raw enum `HISTORICAL` in the currency cell →
   `epistemicFieldValueLabel("currency", …)`; the "historical" mark rides
   the muted-ink `.sig-temporal-mark` word.
4. e2e red ×13 — the coarse `ENTITY_PAGES_EMIT` boolean turned every `/id/`
   stub into a 0-refresh to unemitted entity targets → per-target
   `emittedEntityPaths` check; chrome-nav expectation updated to the
   landed Organizations section; NEW-7 glued boundaries (EpistemicFields
   name/value separator, disclosure colon spacing, figure-slot spacing,
   claim-link separators).
5. `check:lhci` red — generated `lighthouserc*.json` drifted for the new
   routes → regenerated via `gen-lhci.mjs`.
6. `test_leg_l1_good_state_all_green` red — the new `top_level` entry needed
   its post-cutover probe capture → `route_4e2234b73c33.txt` + `routes.tsv`.

## Environment / accepted reds

- Node v25.2.1 locally vs `engines` `>=24 <25` — `check:lhci`'s `lhci`
  invocation crashes under v25; `gen-lhci.mjs --verify` passes; CI Node 24
  is authoritative.
- `test_p34_18_aliases` ×2 + the `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` sentinel — known reds.
- Docker unavailable → `tests/db`/`tests/e2e` skip silently.
